strengths: Edge perception stack is genuinely deep: TensorRT-optimized YOLO on Jetson, 5.2x speedup (56.7 to 10.9 ms), visual servoing in COFFIN
CUDA / inference optimization: custom VGG16 conv kernels, ~35% over naive GPU, plus int8 quantization work
ROS2 Humble + MoveIt/RViz + UR ROS 2 driver on a physical UR5e with collision-free trajectories
CARLA pipeline: auto-generated ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 lane frames from semantic segmentation, zero collisions in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians

real_gaps: No mobile-robot navigation anywhere: no Nav2, SLAM, costmaps, localisation or mapping on a ROS2 mobile base. ROS evidence is arm manipulation only
No LiDAR, point clouds, Open3D or true multimodal 2D+3D fusion
No Docker/containerisation, CI/CD pipeline or automated test suite on a robotics stack
No field deployment or client-facing trials; deployment is a single systemd service on a lab Jetson
No DDS/QoS tuning, no JavaScript, no NeRF/Gaussian Splatting/Omniverse/Unity/Unreal
Seniority: role expects owning and mentoring across the full robotics lifecycle; profile is capstone/research/internship scope
overstated_by_keywords: Nav2 adjacent: MoveIt arm planning is manipulation, not mobile navigation
Sensor Fusion adjacent: CARLA pipeline is single-camera detection plus lane following, not fusion
Obstacle Avoidance adjacent: ToF gating is a grasp trigger, not collision avoidance or rerouting for a mobile platform
Sensor Integration / Automated Testing counted Have: ToF over I2C and bench trials, no LiDAR/camera-on-mobile-base integration and no automated test or CI evidence
ROS2 Have: real but arm-centric, not mobile-robot ROS2 with Nav2 stack
understated_by_keywords: ZoeDepth crack-depth profiling (BARC) is real 3D surface reconstruction work, closest thing to scene reconstruction in the profile
Frame Simulator: SE(3) transform-chain math and visualization maps to TF / spatial reasoning
COFFIN: Flutter client plus Flask-SocketIO edge server over WebSocket is operator-facing tooling with telemetry-like streaming, closest to the JS dashboards ask
Fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect (Robocon) plus ToF range-gating supports the safe-operation theme
Robot Perception and Principles of Robotics coursework (RIT) not captured as keywords
screening_gaps: No Nav2 / SLAM / localisation / mapping on a mobile robot, the core of the role
No LiDAR or 3D point-cloud perception (Open3D) and no real multimodal sensor fusion

llm_analysis.reasoning: The perception and edge-inference half of the role is strongly evidenced (TensorRT/YOLO on Jetson, CUDA, depth estimation, ROS2 on a UR5e). The navigation half, which is the centre of the posting, has no real backing: ROS experience is manipulator-only and there is no LiDAR, SLAM or Nav2. Treat it as a stretch where the perception and edge-AI story has to carry the application.
